audience.text: Developers building Node.js applications that need to parse, edit, and generate PDF documents without external native dependencies.

capabilities.text: Parses classic cross-reference tables and streams, object streams, and all stream filters (FlateDecode, LZWDecode, ASCII85Decode, ASCIIHexDecode, RunLengthDecode) with matching encoders; recovers damaged files and reports what was repaired.
capabilities.title: PDF Parsing and Serialization

capabilities.text: Access and edit every page through doc.Pages with all five boundary boxes, rotation, resources, and decoded content; manipulate the page set with AddPage, InsertPage, RemovePage, Reorder, Split, ExtractPages, Append, and Document.Merge.
capabilities.title: Page Manipulation and Content Editing

capabilities.text: Stamp text with the 12 Standard-14 fonts or embedded TrueType/OpenType/WOFF/WOFF2 fonts; build tables with spans, pagination, and auto-fit columns; create multi-column flow documents with headings, lists, images, floats, and a table of contents.
capabilities.title: Text, Tables, and Flow Layout

capabilities.text: Import HTML (parsed by a real HTML5 tokenizer and styled through a CSS cascade), CommonMark/GFM Markdown, or DOCX into a flow, a page rectangle, or a whole document with AddHtml, AddMarkdown, or AddDocx.
capabilities.title: HTML, Markdown, and DOCX Import

capabilities.text: Create, edit, and enumerate 16 annotation subtypes, outlines, page labels, named destinations, JavaScript, attachments, portfolios, and optional-content layers; fill and style AcroForm fields and regenerate appearances.
capabilities.title: Annotations, Forms, and Optional Content

capabilities.text: Redact content by rectangle or text search, truly removing glyphs and images from the saved file; sanitize hidden data in one call; optimize fonts, images, and structure losslessly.
capabilities.title: Redaction, Sanitization, and Optimization

capabilities.text: Open PDFs protected with the standard security handler (RC4, AES-128, AES-256); write encrypted output with the same handler or certificate-based /Adobe.PubSec; support adbe.pkcs7.detached and ETSI.CAdES.detached signatures with timestamps, LTV data, and full verification.
capabilities.title: Digital Signatures and Encryption

capabilities.text: Render a page to SVG or a raster image (PNG/JPEG/TIFF/BMP/GIF) with a pure-TypeScript software rasterizer; export a whole document to reflowable or fixed-layout HTML, Markdown, DOCX, or EPUB.
capabilities.title: Rendering and Export

limitations.text: The library does not decode or encode image codecs beyond those listed; JPXDecode (JPEG 2000) decoding is supported but encoding is not.
Complex-text shaping requires an embedded font with shape: true; Standard-14 fonts do not shape and an embedded font with shaping off stays byte-identical.
The library does not run JavaScript; it only recognizes and implements Acrobat's 17 standard AForm functions natively when scripts are exactly one such call with literal arguments.
PDF/A-1 transparency is not flattened by default; opt-in with flattenTransparency: true, which rasterizes affected pages and is not reversible.

SVG embedding does not support external hrefs for fonts or images unless opts.resolveImage or opts.resolveImage are provided; a font-family outside the 12 Latin Standard-14 faces is silently substituted.
Incremental save is not combinable with compressed, encrypt, linearized, or streamFilter options, and refuses encrypted and recovery-opened documents.

problems_solved.text: Enables server-side PDF processing in Node.js with no third-party runtime dependencies, using only built-in Node.js modules.
Provides a complete in-memory object model for PDF documents, allowing mutations to be applied directly and serialized to a fresh document on save.
Supports incremental save and digital signing, preserving earlier bytes and enabling long-term validation with embedded timestamps and revocation data.
Offers bounded resource limits during document parsing to prevent memory exhaustion from untrusted inputs.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for TypeScript is a free, open-source, zero-dependency TypeScript library for reading, manipulating, and writing PDF files in Node.js.

uncertainties: The exact behavior of the library when handling malformed or non-standard PDF constructs beyond documented recovery is not fully specified.
The library's handling of certain advanced PDF features like blend modes, soft masks, and transparency groups may not match all viewers exactly.
The library's support for PDF 2.0 features beyond what is documented may be incomplete or untested.
The library's behavior when processing extremely large documents or deeply nested structures under LoadLimits is not fully characterized.
The library's handling of custom or non-standard font encodings beyond the 195 bundled Adobe CMaps is not fully documented.
The library's behavior when processing documents with mixed content streams (e.g., text, images, and annotations) is not fully specified.
The library's handling of certain annotation subtypes or appearance streams may not match all viewers exactly.
The library's behavior when processing documents with complex optional-content configurations is not fully documented.

workflows.name: Open and Edit PDF
workflows.text: Open an existing PDF with Document.Open, edit pages and metadata through the live object model, and save with Document.Save.

workflows.name: Generate PDF from Scratch
workflows.text: Create a new document with Document.New, add pages and content using APIs like AddText, AddImage, AddTable, and Flow, then save the result.

workflows.name: Import and Convert Content
workflows.text: Import HTML, Markdown, plain text, or DOCX into a document or flow using AddHtml, AddMarkdown, AddPlainText, or AddDocx, and export to other formats.

workflows.name: Validate and Remediate Conformance
workflows.text: Validate a document against PDF/A, PDF/UA, or PDF/X standards using ValidatePdfA, ValidatePdfUa, or ValidatePdfX, and remediate with ConvertToPdfA, ConvertToPdfUa, or ConvertToPdfX.

workflows.name: Sign and Secure Documents
workflows.text: Open encrypted PDFs with a password, sign documents with PKCS#12 or PEM credentials, embed timestamps, and apply certificate-based encryption for recipients.

workflows.name: Extract and Redact Content
workflows.text: Extract text, tables, and vector paths from pages, search and replace text, redact content by rectangle or text search, and sanitize hidden data.
